text_block_list.text:
It was during a typical day of working in 
the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll leave the documents right 
here~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... *heave-ho*. Now all that's left is 
to check the shifts and schedule...
(Rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Did something drop...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Could this be...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go on a hot springs trip! A 
hot spring! You won the trip voucher, 
didn't you?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, since we have the chance! Just set a 
schedule, and I'll work around it!

And so, it was decided that I would go on 
a hot springs trip with Ines Fujin—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for staying at our inn 
today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Dinner will be served starting at 18:00, 
so please relax and make yourself at home 
until then.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha, playing inn waitress. I've worked 
part-time at an inn a few times before, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, Trainer's room is so huuuuge! 
The view from the window is so pretty 
too~♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Lucky~ Swap rooms with me~.
choice_data_list:
The scenery wouldn't change that much, 
right?

The scenery wouldn't change that much, 
would it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, you just don't get it! Just the 
slightest angle change completely changes 
the view.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
By the way, want some tea? I'm free, so 
maybe I could give you a massage or 
something?
choice_data_list: No, since we're here, let's just relax.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that's true too. Well then, I think 
I'll laze around too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Trainer. What time is it right now?"
choice_data_list: It hasn't even been an hour yet.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, no way—?! It honestly feels like 
three whole hours have passed already!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Isn't time moving super slow? Is this 
just how ryokans are?"
choice_data_list:
It's 'cause I haven't done anything 
compared to usual.

It's because I haven't done anything 
compared to usual, you know.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"That makes sense. Normally around this 
time, I'd either be at the register or 
running on the track, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If I were back home, would I be grocery 
shopping for dinner right now? Or maybe 
helping my little sisters with their 
homework?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to that, right now... there are 
no customers and no little sisters 
around."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All I could hear were subtle sounds, like 
the quiet rustle of the wind and the soft 
touch of feet lifting off the tatami 
mats...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I'll go soak in the hot springs. 
Wanna come along, Trainer?
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ That felt so good~♪ There weren't 
many people in the open-air bath, so I 
could stretch my legs out all the way~♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. Seriously, there's nothing to do 
until mealtime.
choice_data_list: Why don't you take a nap?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehh. I kind of feel like that's a 
waste."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Because a chance like this might never 
come again. It's kind of like the calm 
before the storm...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. Let's go for a walk. Since 
we're both totally free anyway."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, so refreshing. Just perfect after 
getting out of the bath.
choice_data_list: Was it hot in the room?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, just normal. But I was feeling a 
little warm and cozy, so...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Time is really passing by so 
leisurely today. Usually, it just flies by 
in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Once we get back, the busy days will 
start all over again, won't they?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But still...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Turns out having busy days packed with 
this and that just suited my rhythm 
better.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"So even after returning to the academy, I 
want to spend my days bustling with races, 
part-time jobs, and training, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Will you grant this humble little wish of 
mine?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Don't question it right there! Just say 
yes like a good sport!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, Trainer... Then how about I 
rephrase that?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Will you keep being my Trainer from now 
on?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yay♪ Well then, lookin' forward to 
workin' together♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...May these everyday moments spent with 
you continue on forever."

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Ines Fuujin...
